newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia sees opportunities in pulp prices fall.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia sees opportunities in pulp prices fall.

text.p: The decline of global pulp prices could be to the advantage of Indonesian pulp producers, timber tycoon Muhammad "Bob" Hasan was quoted as saying by the Bisnis Indonesia newspaper on Thursday.

The daily quoted Hasan as saying further declines of pulp prices in the international market could provide opportunities for domestic producers because of low costs of production and the possibility that producers in sub-tropical countries could be forced out of business.
"If the falls continue, it will speed up the bankcrupty of pulp producers in sub-tropical countries," said Hasan, who is also the chairman of Indonesia Foresty Society.
"Indonesia can harvest forests at the age of eight years while sub-tropical countries have to wait until the age of 50 years," he added.
